**install:** `pixel setup` no longer writes the `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop` and `Interrupt` keys into Devin's `hooks`: Devin accepts only PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PermissionRequest, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, PostCompaction, SessionStart and SessionEnd, and rejected the whole block over the unknown keys, so no Pixel Devin hook ran. Install also drops those keys a previous release left emptied.
